notes: st_inspect has been a verb since 5.155.0 and had no pane. Squeak, Pharo and every commercial image have had an inspector for decades; it is the affordance that turns *"the debugger says the receiver is an Alpha"* into *"and here is what is inside it"*. THE FIRST CUT OF THE PANE WAS WRONG, AND DRIVING THE ENGINE IS WHAT CAUGHT IT. It invented label and has_children; the engine emits name and children. Because has_children is simply absent, the Into button rendered on nothing — a drill-down that silently could not drill. Every assertion in the new suite therefore drives st-debug rather than read
